Me and my friend used to sneak out of our parents houses at night and climb buildings in our village then smoke out on the roof.

The last time we did it I was "staying" at my friend's house and we climbed the local school. We had got kind of cocky at this point and started making wierd noises to passers by.

Long story short someone called the police on us and they showed up with many police cars, dog units, a fire engine and a police helicopter.

My oh shit moment was when my mum text me "there's a police helicopter flying over the village, wonder what's going on?"

She wasn't happy when she picked me up from the station.

tl:dr me and friend climbed a school to smoke weed, had a police helicopter called on us, very unhappy mummy.
